name: Kiat Seng Hardware & Marine Supply
conflictDisclosure: Implementation delivered by Maple Commerce. This case is written by the implementer; the conflict of interest is disclosed.
headline: Multi-modal vision and catalog retrieval agent that extracts 300+ daily WhatsApp purchase orders into Autocount ERP, reducing intake time from 3.5 hours to 35 minutes.
officialProfile: Singapore wholesale distributor of marine fasteners, valves, flanges, and rigging hardware operating from Jalan Besar and Tuas, supplying shipyard contractors and regional offshore repair operators.
officialChallenges: Manual data entry of 300+ handwritten, photographed, or voice-note orders sent via WhatsApp by shipyard supervisors every morning between 6:30 AM and 8:30 AM.
Severe SKU mismatch errors caused by non-standard colloquial naming and shipyard slang for over 14,000 marine fastener and flange catalog variants.
Dispatch bottlenecks where four sales coordinators spent 3.5 hours every morning manually rekeying line items into Autocount ERP before warehouse picking could begin.
officialSolution: OrderLens AI (Multi-modal Vision & Catalog Matching Agent)
officialComponents: Multi-modal vision extraction engine reading photographed handwritten purchase orders, invoice chits, and WhatsApp message screenshots.
Dense vector semantic catalog retriever searching 14,000 product SKUs with colloquial Singapore shipyard alias mapping.
Staging and automated validation ledger checking inventory stock levels, credit terms, and minimum order quantities.
Human-in-the-loop exception dashboard highlighting low-confidence SKU matches for 1-click coordinator approval.
Robotic desktop integration pipeline posting approved orders into Autocount SQL ERP via API/ODBC bridge.

scqa.s: Kiat Seng Hardware & Marine Supply operates as a key distributor of industrial fasteners and marine rigging supplies across Singapore's shipyards, managing over 14,000 catalog SKUs.
scqa.c: Every morning between 6:30 AM and 8:30 AM, more than 300 emergency replenishment orders arrive via WhatsApp from shipyard foremen as photos of handwritten chits, whiteboard notes, and text messages using colloquial terminology. Four sales coordinators spent 3.5 hours manually transcribing these into Autocount ERP, creating shipping delays and a 6.2% line-item error rate.
scqa.q: How could Kiat Seng automate the intake, SKU normalization, and ERP staging of non-standard morning WhatsApp purchase orders without changing the foremen's ordering habits?
scqa.a: Maple Commerce designed and deployed OrderLens AI: a multi-modal pipeline combining Claude 3.5 Sonnet Vision for handwritten chit parsing, a Qdrant vector database embedding shipyard aliases to standard SKUs, and an exception-only human approval dashboard before automated posting into Autocount ERP.

takeaway: Legacy ERP systems can be automated without replacement by placing vision LLMs and domain-specific vector alias indexes at the intake boundary.

claims.text: Morning purchase order backlog cleared in 35 minutes down from 3.5 hours.
Catalog alias vector index maps colloquial shipyard terms to 14,000 formal ERP SKUs.

stack.what: Claude 3.5 Sonnet Vision API for handwritten chit parsing and structured JSON extraction
Qdrant vector database with custom embeddings mapping colloquial shipyard slang to ERP SKUs
Self-hosted n8n workflow engine managing WhatsApp Business webhooks and staging queues
Python ODBC connector staging approved transactions directly into Autocount SQL database
Retool web dashboard for 1-click coordinator approval of items below 95% semantic match confidence

timeline.event: Discovery workshop and sample collection of 1,500 historical WhatsApp order photos
Beta deployment of OrderLens AI staging queue alongside parallel manual entry
Full production cutover; 100% of morning WhatsApp orders processed via AI pipeline

requirements: WhatsApp Business API or cloud email intake webhook.

steps: Export and vectorize full product catalog into a dense vector database (e.g. Qdrant or pgvector).

Connect automated staging to ERP test database before scheduling production cutover.
risks: Handwriting ambiguity on faded paper receipts requiring mandatory coordinator review.
Out-of-stock items requiring real-time inventory quantity checks before ERP order creation.

headline: Automated ACRA Bizfile data extraction and AML/KYC screening agent that cut annual compliance review cycle from 45 minutes to 6.5 minutes across 1,200 entities.
officialProfile: Singapore corporate secretarial and accounting practice managing annual compliance filings, statutory registers, and ACRA Bizfile maintenance for over 1,200 active corporate clients.
officialChallenges: Manual extraction and cross-referencing of officer details, shareholder registers, and Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBO) from multi-page ACRA Bizfile PDF profiles.
Labor-intensive Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Countering Financing of Terrorism (CFT) screening requiring manual queries across sanctions lists and PEP registries.
Peak filing deadline compression between April and June where junior corporate secretarial staff faced 60-hour work weeks to avoid ACRA late-lodgment penalties.
officialSolution: ComplianceClerk AI (Automated ACRA Parsing & AML Screening Suite)
officialComponents: ACRA Bizfile PDF document parser extracting corporate structure, directors, and UBO chains into structured JSON schemas.
Automated AML/PEP screening engine querying international sanctions databases and adverse news registries.
Risk assessment report generator producing standardized compliance audit packs with source citations.
Annual filing deadline tracker synchronizing entity financial year ends with ACRA statutory calendar.
E-signature dispatcher preparing client confirmation packs via DocuSign webhook integration.

scqa.s: Alliance Business Advisory provides corporate secretarial, accounting, and registered agent services for 1,200 Singapore SMEs and international subsidiaries.
scqa.c: Under ACRA and AML/CFT regulations, every corporate client must undergo annual identity re-verification, UBO tracing, and adverse media screening. Reviewing each entity manually took 45 minutes, creating a massive seasonal logjam that pushed staff to capacity limits and incurred occasional late-filing fines.
scqa.q: How could Alliance automate the extraction of ACRA Bizfile data and AML sanctions screening while maintaining strict audit traceability for regulatory inspection?
scqa.a: Maple Commerce implemented ComplianceClerk AI: an automated pipeline that ingests ACRA Bizfile PDFs, extracts corporate structures using GPT-4o mini, executes automated PEP/sanctions lookups, and compiles a comprehensive PDF audit pack for senior compliance officer sign-off in 6.5 minutes.

takeaway: Regulated compliance workflows can be compressed by 85% by automating document extraction and external database verification while preserving a human compliance officer as the final signer.

claims.text: Annual corporate compliance review completed in 6.5 minutes per entity.
Zero statutory deadline misses across 1,200 managed corporate entities.

name: A 14-Staff Precision Engineering & Tooling Distributor
conflictDisclosure: Implementation delivered by Maple Commerce. This case is written by the implementer; the conflict of interest is disclosed.
headline: On-premise RFP analysis and multi-vendor margin optimization engine that reduced complex 5-axis tooling quotation turnaround from 36 hours to 45 minutes.
officialProfile: Singapore precision tooling distributor based in Jurong, supplying specialized carbide cutting tools, collets, and CNC toolholders to aerospace, semiconductor, and medical device manufacturers across Southeast Asia.
officialChallenges: Complex multi-line Requests for Quotation (RFQs) containing 40 to 120 technical tool specifications in unstructured engineering formats (DWG notes, scanned PDFs, Excel spreadsheets).
Manual cross-referencing across eight international supplier catalogs (Germany, Japan, Switzerland) with constantly fluctuating currency exchange rates and tier-based discounts.
Quotation bottlenecks taking 24 to 48 hours per technical bid, causing the distributor to lose time-sensitive RFQ bids to faster overseas competitors.
officialSolution: QuoteFast AI (On-Premise RFQ Technical Spec Parser & Pricing Engine)
officialComponents: Local air-gapped LLM parsing technical engineering drawings, geometry callouts, and carbide grade codes.
Multi-supplier catalog pricing engine calculating landed import costs, dynamic foreign exchange hedging, and recommended gross margin tiers.
Alternative tooling recommender identifying interchangeable, lower-cost certified equivalent tools.
Excel sales engineer add-in generating formal customer quotation PDFs with 1-click review.
Strict on-premise local server deployment satisfying strict aerospace client Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs).

scqa.s: A 14-staff precision tooling distributor in Jurong distributes high-precision CNC cutting tools to aerospace and precision machining sub-contractors in Singapore and Malaysia.
scqa.c: Customers submit complex technical RFQ packages demanding exact tooling geometry matching. Technical sales engineers spent 36 to 48 hours manually searching supplier catalogs and calculating landed margin formulas. Due to customer defense and aerospace NDAs, cloud-based AI tools like ChatGPT or public APIs were strictly forbidden.
scqa.q: How could the distributor automate technical tooling specification matching and quotation pricing while keeping 100% of customer data on a local air-gapped server?
scqa.a: Maple Commerce architected and deployed QuoteFast AI: an on-premise solution running Mistral Large via Ollama on an air-gapped workstation, paired with DuckDB local catalog caches and an Excel add-in that matches engineering specs and generates quotation drafts in 45 minutes.

takeaway: Strict client confidentiality and aerospace NDAs do not prevent AI adoption; on-premise open-weight LLMs can deliver custom-grade quotation automation without a byte leaving local hardware.

claims.text: Technical RFQ quotation turnaround compressed from 36 hours to 45 minutes.
100% local on-premise execution with zero cloud transmission for customer drawings.

stack.what: Mistral Large (open-weight) running locally via Ollama on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 workstation
DuckDB embedded analytical database storing 45,000 international supplier tooling SKUs with currency matrix
LangGraph local Python pipeline coordinating spec parsing, price lookup, and margin optimization
Custom Microsoft Excel VSTO add-in allowing sales engineers to review suggestions within their familiar workflow
